records.question: How do I set up Model A versus Model B?

expected.answer: Model A: connect power, hold SETUP for 3 seconds, select channel 1. Model B: connect power, open the front cover, set MODE to B, press START.

actual.answer: For Model A: connect the power adapter, press and hold the SETUP button for 3 seconds until the status light blinks green, then select channel 1 on the CHANNEL dial (do not select channel 2). For Model B: connect the power adapter, open the front cover, set the MODE switch to position B, then press START.

citations.quote: 2. Setup: Model A
Step 1. Connect the power adapter.
Step 2. Press and hold the SETUP button for 3 seconds until the status light blinks green.
Step 3. Select channel 1 on the CHANNEL dial.
Do not select channel 2 during setup. Channel 2 is reserved for service mode.
3. Setup: Model B
Step 1. Connect the power adapter.
Step 2. Open the front cover.
Step 3. Set the MODE switch to position B.
Step 4. Press START.
Model B has no SETUP button. Holding START for more than 10 seconds resets Model B to factory settings.

actual.resolvedQuery: How do I set up Model A versus Model B?
